skills.description: 从已完成正文和已核实结果生成或修订医学论文标题、结构化摘要与关键词，并按目标期刊当前作者须知核对 分节、字数和必报信息。当用户要求写摘要、压缩摘要、起学术标题或制作中英双语摘要时使用；不从缺失正文 中编造结果，也不把内置期刊配置当作实时官方要求。 Use for medical manuscript titles, structured abstracts and bilingual abstracts.

skills.name: dyz-med-analyze
skills.description: 对医学研究原始数据做只读结构与质量检查，先形成可审阅的统计分析计划，获用户明确批准后再生成并运行本地 R 或既定统计代码，交付脚本、日志、诊断和可追溯结果。当用户要求分析 CSV、Excel、SPSS、Stata 等患者级 数据或拟定统计方案时使用；仅判断数据能支持什么问题交给 dyz-med-data-adequacy，解释既有结果交给 dyz-med-interpret，检验既有结果稳健性则交给 dyz-med-sensitivity。 Use for biostatistical analysis planning and approved R or other local…

skills.name: dyz-med-cnki
skills.description: 为医学主题设计并执行可复现的中英文文献检索，产出查询式、检索记录和去重后的候选文献池。当用户要“查文献” “覆盖 PubMed 和中文来源”或核实某研究问题的文献范围时使用；本技能负责发现与记录，深度精读交给 dyz-med-key-literature，系统综述的正式筛选与纳入流程交给 dyz-med-screening-pipeline。无法直接访问知网、万方或 维普时只能提供 discovery_only 线索，不得声称完成了数据库检索或全文获取。 Use for PubMed and Chinese medical literature search; database…

skills.name: dyz-med-data-adequacy
skills.description: 在统计分析和论文写作前检查医学数据能否支持计划问题、模型和论断，产出数据充分性报告、异常清单、待临床 确认问题及可接受的分析范围。当用户问“这些数据够不够”“能支持什么结论”或准备分析前需要数据把关时使用； 实际建模交给 dyz-med-analyze，已有统计结果的临床解释交给 dyz-med-interpret，不能据此承诺期刊或分区。 Use to assess medical research data adequacy before statistical analysis.

skills.name: dyz-med-deai
skills.description: 在不改变医学事实和证据的前提下，改善医学论文中模板化、重复、空泛或机械的语言，使表达更自然、具体且 符合作者语气。当用户说文字“太像 AI”“太模板化”“不自然”或要求医学学术语言自然化时使用；本 Skill 不用于规避 AI 检测，不判断文本作者身份，也不删除必要的 AI 使用披露。 Use to improve repetitive academic prose while preserving facts and disclosure; not detector evasion.

skills.name: dyz-med-discussion
skills.description: 基于已核实结果、研究设计和文献证据撰写或修订医学论文讨论部分，覆盖主要发现、与既有证据的比较、合理 解释、局限性、适用性和结论边界。当用户明确要写讨论、解释结果或修复过度声称时使用；不改写统计结果， 不把引用次数当作证据质量，也不编造机制或未来研究样本量。 Use to draft or revise medical discussions, evidence comparisons and limitations.

skills.name: dyz-med-evidence-audit
skills.description: 核对医学稿件中的关键论断是否被所引文献、指南、用户数据或明确标注的推断真正支持，输出逐条论断—证据 矩阵、来源定位和待处理问题。当用户要求检查引用是否对题、论断有没有依据、知识缺口是否夸大或结论是否 超出证据时使用；不代替完整同行评议、报告规范检查或参考文献排版。 Use to audit manuscript claims against cited literature and study evidence.

skills.name: dyz-med-export
skills.description: 将已完成的医学稿件及其参考文献、表格和图片整理为目标期刊要求的 Word、PDF 或其他交付格式，并核对 跨节数字、引用和图表链接。当用户要求导出 DOCX、合并稿件、套用期刊格式或制作可审阅文件时使用； 不改动原始稿件、不假设本地工具存在，也不把导出等同于投稿或科学内容通过审核。 Use to assemble basic DOCX review drafts; advanced formatting requires suitable external tools.

skills.name: dyz-med-figures-tables
skills.description: 规划、生成和核对医学论文的结果表格与统计图，建立数据来源清单，检查正文、图表和已执行分析输出的一致性， 并生成可审阅的标题、图注和脚注。当用户问“需要哪些图表”“帮我做森林图/Table 1”或要求核对图文数字时 使用；CONSORT、STROBE、PRISMA 等流程图由 dyz-med-flowchart 专门处理。 Use for medical manuscript tables, statistical figures and text–figure consistency.

skills.name: dyz-med-flowchart
skills.description: 从可追溯的研究流程计数生成并核对随机试验、观察性研究、系统综述或范围综述流程图，交付结构化计数、 Mermaid/可渲染图稿、图注和流程叙述。当用户要求 CONSORT、STROBE、PRISMA 或 PRISMA-ScR 流程图时使用； 文献去重与筛选由 dyz-med-screening-pipeline 负责，其他统计图表由 dyz-med-figures-tables 负责。 Use for PRISMA, CONSORT and observational study flow diagrams from traceable counts.

skills.name: dyz-med-guideline
skills.description: 按当前适用的医学研究报告规范逐条核对稿件，标记 COVERED、PARTIAL、MISSING、NOT_APPLICABLE，并给出 可定位的修改建议。当用户明确要检查 CONSORT、STROBE、PRISMA、STARD、CARE、TRIPOD、ARRIVE、SPIRIT 等规范符合性时使用；笼统稿件诊断、论断证据核查和模拟审稿分别交给相应技能，本技能不出具合规认证。 Use to check applicable medical reporting guidelines including STROBE, CONSORT and PRISMA.

skills.name: dyz-med-ideate
skills.description: 把尚未成形的临床观察、兴趣领域、导师方向或数据库线索，转化为结构化且可验证的医学研究问题，并完成 PICO、PECO、PICOS、FINER、机制层级和初步文献缺口判断。当用户说“不知道研究什么”“这个想法能否 做成课题”“想找一个可执行选题”时使用；已有明确问题和数据需要立项时转交 dyz-med-init，已有稿件时不要使用。 Use for clinical research ideation, PICO questions and feasibility exploration.

skills.name: dyz-med-init
skills.description: 为已有明确研究问题、研究设计和数据或结果的医学论文创建写作项目，识别研究类型、匹配当前报告规范、检查 可行性与关键风险，并生成最小 IMRaD 骨架。当用户说“研究已经做完，准备开始写论文”或要初始化新论文项目 时使用；尚未形成研究问题时先用 dyz-med-ideate，已有稿件需要评估时转 dyz-med-manuscript-diagnose。 Use to initialize a medical manuscript project from an established study.

skills.name: dyz-med-interpret
skills.description: 把既有医学统计结果与预先规定、来源可追溯的临床重要阈值放在同一尺度上，区分统计证据、效应大小和临床 重要性，产出逐结局解释表及谨慎措辞。当用户问“显著但有临床意义吗”“区间是否排除重要获益或伤害”时使用； 不负责重新建模或计算原始数据，也不替代 dyz-med-sensitivity 的稳健性分析。 Use to interpret existing statistical results and clinical importance without rerunning models.

skills.name: dyz-med-introduction
skills.description: 基于已确认的研究问题、论证地图和已核实文献撰写或修订医学论文引言，形成临床背景、已有证据、具体知识 缺口与研究目的之间的清晰逻辑。当用户明确要写引言或修复引言逻辑时使用；不负责讨论、结果解释或整篇统稿。 Use to draft or revise a medical manuscript introduction and research rationale.

skills.name: dyz-med-journal-finder
skills.description: 根据医学稿件的主题、文章类型、研究设计、目标读者、开放获取预算和时间要求，核实候选期刊的当前范围、 投稿要求与费用并给出分层短名单。当用户问“适合投什么期刊”“这本期刊匹配吗”或需要改投梯队时使用； 不承诺录用，不凭记忆提供影响因子、接受率、审稿周期或版面费。 Use for medical journal selection based on verified scope, requirements and fees.

skills.name: dyz-med-key-literature
skills.description: 从已有候选文献池中筛选前沿、奠基、指南、系统综述、矛盾证据和本土关键文献，完成全文级结构化精读并形成 可复用的文献地图、单篇简报和证据综合。当用户要“精读几篇关键论文”“找绕不开的文献”或核对与结论矛盾的 研究时使用；从零检索文献应先用 dyz-med-cnki，只有摘要或题录时不得声称已完成深度精读。 Use for critical appraisal and synthesis of available full-text medical literature.

skills.name: dyz-med-manuscript-diagnose
skills.description: 对用户已有的医学稿件、部分草稿、摘要、表格、拒稿信或审稿意见做只读现状诊断，给出材料清单、当前阶段、 主要科学与写作风险、投稿准备度和优先级。当用户想先知道“这篇稿子现在有什么问题、下一步怎么走”时使用； 本 Skill 不直接改写稿件，具体修订交给 dyz-med-revision 或分节 Skill。 Use for read-only manuscript assessment and revision priorities.

skills.name: dyz-med-mechanism
skills.description: 检验和升级医学研究问题的机制与因果逻辑，支持机制链检查、临床与基础双向转化、AI 模型解释、研究再设计、 因果图和中介分析方案。当用户询问“机制是否说得通”“能否从相关性升级”“如何构建因果图或中介路径”时 使用；不负责从零选题，也不把关联、特征重要性或预测性能解释为因果机制。 Use to examine causal reasoning, mechanism hypotheses and study logic.

skills.name: dyz-med-methods
skills.description: 根据研究方案、实际执行记录和统计分析计划撰写或修订医学论文方法部分。当用户需要把研究设计、研究对象、 变量测量、偏倚控制、统计方法及适用的伦理注册信息写成可复核正文时使用；不替用户设计未确认的方法， 不运行统计分析，也不编造批件号、日期、软件版本或数据共享安排。 Use to write methods sections from actual study procedures and approved analysis plans.

skills.name: dyz-med-orchestrator
skills.description: 读取医学论文项目状态与现有工件，生成当前进度地图、关键风险和一个最合适的下一步建议。当用户问“现在 到哪一步”“下一步做什么”“从哪里开始”或需要澄清多种医学任务的选择时使用；状态查询只推荐下一步， 明确的自然语言任务直接匹配最窄职责 Skill，无需说出技能名；不自动串联后续阶段或宣告稿件可投稿。 Use to review medical research workflow progress and recommend the next task.

skills.name: dyz-med-passport
skills.description: 供医学论文工作流内部读取和更新项目状态文件，记录已确认事实、产出版本、来源、开放问题、人工批准和质量 检查历史。当其他 dyz-med-* Skill 需要共享项目状态或避免重复询问时使用；用户想查看进度时优先使用 dyz-med-orchestrator。本 Skill 只记录已有事实，不作医学判断，也不把缺失字段自动填成已确认。 Use internally to maintain confirmed project facts, provenance and artifact versions.

skills.name: dyz-med-registration
skills.description: 从官方注册平台核实临床试验或其他研究的注册记录，并与方案、分析计划和稿件交叉检查注册时间、研究设计、 结局、样本量及结果报告差异。当用户提供 NCT、ChiCTR、ISRCTN、UMIN 等注册号，询问是否前瞻注册、是否 存在结局切换或需要注册声明时使用；报告规范的全面检查交给 dyz-med-guideline，未查到原始记录时不得生成 确定性注册声明。 Use to check trial registration records against protocols and manuscripts.

skills.name: dyz-med-results
skills.description: 把已核实的统计输出、表格和图转写为医学论文结果部分，保持样本量、效应量、置信区间、P 值、模型及分析 层级可追溯。当用户需要撰写或修订结果正文、图表引用或数值一致性时使用；不运行新分析、不补造缺失数字， 也不承担讨论解释。 Use to write results sections while preserving verified effect estimates and numerical provenance.

skills.name: dyz-med-review
skills.description: 对接近投稿状态的医学稿件做五个视角的模拟审稿：证据、方法统计、伦理合规、临床领域与期刊编辑，并汇总 为定位明确的 PASS、REVISE 或 REJECT 建议。当用户要求投稿前全面把关、模拟同行评议或评估拒稿风险时 使用；这是决策支持，不是真实同行评议，也不会自动修改、导出或投稿。 Use for simulated pre-submission peer review and located revision recommendations.

skills.name: dyz-med-revision
skills.description: 修订已有医学稿件或逐条回应编辑和审稿人意见，覆盖语言、结构、科学表述、改投适配和拒稿后恢复，并保留 可追溯的修改记录。当用户明确要求修改稿件、回复审稿意见或按新期刊重整时使用；先给修订计划，文字和 格式修改可在授权范围内执行，涉及新数据、重分析、伦理、作者或其他源事实时必须先获得确认。 Use for manuscript revision, response to reviewers and journal resubmission preparation.

skills.name: dyz-med-screening-pipeline
skills.description: 管理系统综述、Meta 分析或范围综述从检索导入、保守去重、标题摘要与全文筛选，到研究/报告关联、数据提取 和 PRISMA 计数的可审计证据链。当用户要执行文献筛选、记录纳排理由或准备证据合成输入时使用；研究问题与 方案设计不是本技能的主要任务，流程图交给 dyz-med-flowchart，原始研究数据统计与合并模型交给 dyz-med-analyze。 Use for systematic review and meta-analysis screening, extraction and PRISMA counts.

skills.name: dyz-med-sensitivity
skills.description: 围绕既有医学研究结果的具体不确定性，规划、执行或记录替代模型、缺失数据、偏倚假设、分析人群和研究纳入 变化，产出可追溯的稳健性比较与局限性说明。当用户问“结果稳不稳”“换假设会不会变”或明确要求敏感性分析 时使用；原始主分析交给 dyz-med-analyze，临床重要性解释交给 dyz-med-interpret。 Use for approved sensitivity analyses and robustness comparisons of existing findings.

skills.name: dyz-med-submit
skills.description: 根据目标期刊当前要求准备医学论文投稿包，包括投稿信、题名页、作者贡献、利益冲突、数据可用性及其他 指定附件。当用户要求准备投稿材料、cover letter 或投稿前清单时使用；默认只生成本地文件，绝不自动 上传、发送、点击提交或创建外部数据仓库，任何外部提交动作都需要用户另行明确授权并最终确认。 Use to prepare local cover letters and journal submission packages; external submission needs authorization.

skills.name: dyz-med-translate
skills.description: 在中文与英文之间忠实翻译医学论文、摘要、投稿材料或审稿回复，统一医学术语，同时逐项保护数字、单位、 统计量、引用、伦理与注册信息。当用户明确要求中译英、英译中或制作双语版本时使用；不负责大范围内容 重构，也不会为了“符合学术写作”补造原文缺失的效应量、事实或引用。 Use for Chinese–English medical translation with numerical, citation and terminology preservation.

skills.name: dyz-med-write
skills.description: 在用户明确要求时，把已确认的医学研究材料一次性整合为完整初稿，或对已完成的各章节做全文连贯性与 一致性修订。当用户说“一次性写成全文”“合成一稿”或“全文统稿”时使用；默认分节写作仍由 dyz-med-introduction、dyz-med-methods、dyz-med-results、dyz-med-discussion 和 dyz-med-abstract 分别负责。 Use for explicitly requested full manuscript drafts or coherence editing across completed sections.

skills.name: dyz-med-writing-plan
skills.description: 在医学论文成文前，把已确认的研究问题、研究设计、统计结果和文献证据整理成全文论证地图与段落级写作计划。 当用户想先理清论文逻辑、章节任务、论断边界或证据分配时使用；不代替分节撰写、统计分析或文献真实性核查。 Use for medical manuscript argument maps and paragraph-level writing plans.

skills.name: sciwrite-manuscript
skills.description: Structure a scientific paper section by section — tables and figures, Results, Methods, Introduction, Discussion, Abstract — following Stanford's Writing in the Sciences. Use this skill whenever someone is writing, drafting, planning, restructuring or reviewing any part of a research paper,…

skills.name: sciwrite-outreach
skills.description: Communicate science to non-specialists: lay summaries, plain-language abstracts, press releases, science news stories, talking to journalists, presenting risk numbers honestly, interviewing a scientist, and using social media. Based on Stanford's Writing in the Sciences. Use this skill whenever…

skills.name: sciwrite-process
skills.description: Plan and run the writing process for a scientific paper or thesis chapter — pre-writing and organisation, drafting fast without perfectionism, revision, and the final pre-submission checklist — following Stanford's Writing in the Sciences. Use this skill whenever someone is stuck, procrastinating,…

skills.name: sciwrite-proposals
skills.description: Write the documents an academic career runs on besides papers: narrative review articles, grant and fellowship applications (specific aims, research plan), letters of recommendation, and personal statements. Based on Stanford's Writing in the Sciences. Use this skill whenever someone mentions…

skills.name: sciwrite-prose
skills.description: Edit and tighten scientific or technical prose at the sentence and paragraph level, using the method taught in Stanford's Writing in the Sciences. Use this skill whenever someone asks you to review, edit, tighten, clean up, polish or improve any piece of research writing — a paper, thesis chapter,…

skills.name: sciwrite-publish
skills.description: Navigate publication: choosing a journal, the submission process, responding to reviewers after a revise-and-resubmit, performing a peer review yourself, authorship decisions and order, plagiarism and self-plagiarism, and spotting predatory journals. Based on Stanford's Writing in the Sciences.…

skills.name: update-default-models
skills.description: Monthly refresh of the default LLM models of Theia's language model aliases (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google), including the per-model capability tables that cannot be auto-discovered. Use when asked to update the default models, aliases or provider model lists.

skills.name: update-dependency
skills.description: Update dependencies of the Theia framework and record what was learned. Its main use is the post-release dependency update after every minor release (NPM upgrade that reduces dependency vulnerabilities reported by npm audit and Dependabot, Electron update, Node.js/React check). Also covers single…

skills.description: Analyze a codebase to produce an interactive knowledge graph for understanding architecture, components, and relationships

skills.name: understand-chat
skills.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

skills.name: understand-dashboard
skills.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

skills.name: understand-diff
skills.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

skills.name: understand-domain
skills.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

skills.name: understand-explain
skills.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

skills.name: understand-figma
skills.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

skills.name: understand-knowledge
skills.description: Analyze a Karpathy-pattern LLM wiki knowledge base and generate an interactive knowledge graph with entity extraction, implicit relationships, and topic clustering.

skills.name: understand-onboard

skills.name: cco
skills.description: In Claude Code: what this session costs and where the tokens go, plus the tools to cut it — /cco for the board, /cco audit, /cco task, /cco pack and more. Use when the user asks about session cost, context size, savings, or wants a task tracked across /compact.

skills.name: doc-digest
skills.description: Turn a long document, PDF, transcript, spreadsheet or log into a compact working digest the conversation can continue from. skills.name: principle-attack-the-premise
skills.description: Apply when two or more fixes that share one premise have failed the same gate. Write the premise down and test it directly before you write another fix that assumes it.

skills.name: principle-boundary-discipline
skills.description: Apply when wiring validation, error handling, or framework adapters. Concentrate guards at system boundaries (CLI, config, network, external APIs); trust internal types and keep business logic in pure functions.

skills.name: principle-build-the-lever
skills.description: Apply to any non-trivial work, not just bulk work: edits, migrations, analyses, checks. Build the tool that does it or proves it (codemod, script, generator, or a skill your subagents follow) instead of working by hand. The tool is the artifact a reviewer can rerun.

skills.name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
skills.description: Apply when you catch yourself writing the same instruction a second time, or notice a recurring correction. Encode the rule as a lint, metadata flag, runtime check, or script instead of more text.

skills.name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
skills.description: Apply when facing a novel UI interaction or architectural decision with no precedent in the codebase. Build 2-3 competing prototypes and compare side by side before committing.

skills.name: principle-experience-first
skills.description: Apply when product, UX, or feature-scope tradeoffs come up. Choose user delight over implementation convenience; ship fewer polished features over more rough ones.

skills.name: principle-explain-the-number
skills.description: Apply before you measure, and before you trust, report, or act on a number you measured: a speedup, a regression, a throughput, a latency, or an eval result. Find what limits it, and rule out that it measured something other than the work you think.

skills.name: principle-fix-root-causes
skills.description: Apply when debugging. Trace each symptom back to the first place the system went wrong and fix it there. A guard is a fix only when the state it handles is legitimate.

skills.name: principle-foundational-thinking
skills.description: Apply before writing logic: choosing core types and data structures, sequencing scaffold-vs-feature work, asking what concurrent actors share. Get the data structures right so downstream code becomes obvious.

skills.name: principle-guard-the-context-window
skills.description: Apply when context is filling up: large outputs, long files, repeated reads, fan-out planning. Route bulk to subagents; keep summaries in the main thread, not raw payloads.

skills.name: principle-laziness-protocol
skills.description: Apply when refactoring, evaluating diff size, or tempted to add abstractions, layers, or signal threading. Bias toward deletion and the smallest change that solves the problem.

skills.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
skills.description: Apply when designing commands, lifecycle steps, or processing loops that run amid crashes, restarts, and retries. Converge to the same end state regardless of partial prior runs.

skills.name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
skills.description: Apply when introducing a new internal API while old callers still exist. Migrate callers and delete the old API in the same wave instead of preserving compatibility layers.

skills.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
skills.description: Apply when reviewing or shaping code that's hard to trace. Count layers between question and answer, and hidden state in the reader's head; collapse one-caller wrappers and shrink mutable scope.

skills.name: principle-model-the-domain
skills.description: Apply when writing stateful logic, or when code branches a lot or repeats a shape assumption across files.

skills.name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
skills.description: Apply when tempted to ask 'should I do X?' on reversible work.

skills.name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
skills.description: Apply during planned rewrites and migrations with explicit phase boundaries. Converge on the target architecture; don't preserve smooth intermediate states with throwaway compatibility code.

skills.name: principle-prove-it-works
skills.description: Apply after completing a task, before declaring done. Verify against the real artifact (run the feature, read the actual value, inspect the diff), not a proxy, self-report, or 'it compiles.'

skills.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
skills.description: Apply when integrating a new requirement into an existing design.

skills.name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
skills.description: Apply when concurrent actors might write to the same file, branch, key, or state object. Eliminate the sharing first; serialize structurally only when one shared writer is a real invariant.

skills.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
skills.description: Apply to multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and to how you stack commits and PRs. Break work into small units that each end in a verifiable state, check each before the next, and order delivery so the sequence proves itself to a reviewer.

skills.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
skills.description: Apply when sequencing an addition, refactor, or rewrite. Remove dead code, redundant validators, and stub references first, then build on the simpler base.

skills.name: principle-test-behavior-not-implementation
skills.description: Apply when you write, change, or keep a test. Assert what the code's users can observe, so that the test fails when that behavior breaks and keeps passing when only the internals change.

skills.name: principle-type-system-discipline
skills.description: Apply when designing types, reviewing a function signature, or writing code in any statically-typed language. Make illegal states unrepresentable, brand semantic primitives, parse external data at boundaries, exhaust variants, derive from authoritative schemas.
